scripts.build:body: uv run --with numpy --with scipy --with pillow python -I scripts/build_body.py "$MAKEHUMAN_DATA" . "$MAKEHUMAN_ASSETS" && gltf-transform sparse assets/models/body.raw.glb assets/models/body.sparse.glb && gltf-transform meshopt assets/models/body.sparse.glb assets/models/body.glb && rm assets/models/body.raw.glb assets/models/body.sparse.glb && for f in assets/models/hair/*.raw.glb; do gltf-transform meshopt "$f" "${f%.raw.glb}.glb" && rm "$f"; done
